blood.source_notes: Dimensionless accessible blood-volume proxies, not litres or kill-score buffs. Injury stops adding when dead; fatal increment excludes previously shed blood. No full-village resource sum.
blood.growth_formula: s=1-exp(-accessible_units/18); bounded dimensions interpolate by s. Final emotional amplification multiplies dimensions by up to 1.22 locally; never speed. State labels use actual accessible units: <2 Awakened, 2-12 Fed,12-32 Saturated,>=32 Deluge.
blood.sense: Signals aggregate nearby living sources into coarse presence/density bearings. Quiet single signals attenuate severely; stone attenuates more than timber. No exact headcount/identity is returned to Blood decisions.
blood.reuse: Sources remain at their causal locations; draw is bounded by current control radius. Recently controlled blood may be carried, with finite capacity and conservation ledger; no remote teleport/global access.

witch.arrival: Recomputed from preserved MainStreet, stair route, courtyard and minimal mansion interior walk. No V1 timing imported.
witch.final_death: Mayor personally killed exactly at arrival+60, irrespective of survivors. No post-terminal fatalities.

bone.recognition: Must have local sight; no remote identity knowledge. Prolong rather than immediate kill. Precise final strike before terminal; no other guard guilt assigned.

civilians.knowledge: Separate direct sight, sound, warning and inference. B4 only direct witnessed reactive attack; warnings record report without falsely claiming witnessed contact.

phase_contract: Each call selects one action commitment from current percepts, then separate reaction decisions; commitments move on one continuous clock. Reactions cannot retroactively change a resolved action; new stimuli go to the next action decision.
